one_liner: Gorgias has a broad REST API (Basic auth with per-user API key; OAuth2 only for approved public apps) and an official MCP, but API access requires a paid helpdesk plan.
auth_notes: Private apps use an API key sent via HTTP Basic (email:API key). OAuth2 authorization-code is mandatory for public apps, but requires a partner account and Gorgias approval before the app is installable, so it is not self-serve for multi-user use.
access_notes: API is available on all helpdesk plans, which are paid. No free tier or trial is evidenced in the snippets. Admins create the key in Settings → REST API. Public OAuth apps need a partner signup and review.
blocker_notes: Builder needs a paid Gorgias helpdesk account (trial not confirmed in the evidence) to obtain an API key. OAuth2 for multi-user needs partner app approval.

evidence.quote: Once [approved by our team](/docs/5-submit-app-for-review) , your app will appear in our in-product App Store
It lets you read and write almost everything in your helpdesk programmatically: tickets, customers, messages, events, tags, integrations, and the sidebar widgets your agents see.
The Gorgias MCP provides a first-party bridge, giving you a secure, direct connection between your chosen AI assistant and your Gorgias account.
Model Context Protocol server for Gorgias.
